home_page__hero_description: Build with TanStack Start, Hono, and oRPC. Authentication, database access, and internationalization are wired in from the start.
home_page__integrations__description: TanStack Start works with most major cloud providers and JavaScript runtimes thanks to the Nitro Vite plugin and our Docker templates.
home_page__setup_link_description: Scaffold a project, configure it, and run it locally.
home_page__setup_scaffold_description: With Vite+ and Docker running locally, scaffold a new project and let the CLI set up PostgreSQL for you.
home_page__setup_configure_description: The installer writes an environment file and applies the database migrations. Change the generated URLs if you use different ports.
home_page__setup_develop_description: Start both apps from the workspace root, then open localhost:3000/web.
home_page__cta_description: Read our documentation to get started with tsu-stack or check out our GitHub repository.
home_page__faq_description: Find out what comes with the starter and how to make it your own.
home_page__faq_about_answer: tsu!stack is a TypeScript starter that brings the web app, API, and database together in one workspace.
home_page__faq_included_answer: The starter includes a TanStack Start web app, a Hono and oRPC API, Drizzle for data access, and Better Auth for sign-in and sessions.
home_page__faq_start_question: How do I start a project?
home_page__faq_start_answer: Run npm create tsu-stack@latest my-app. The CLI walks you through your project name, deployment variant, and optional local setup.
home_page__faq_styling_answer: Yes. The shared UI package contains the component source and theme styles, so you can adjust both directly in your project.
home_page__faq_locales_answer: Yes. Paraglide handles translations and locale-aware routes. Add a locale and its messages in the internationalization package.
home_page__faq_deploy_answer: The scaffolding CLI offers separate or merged Node apps and Cloudflare Worker variants. The Node starter includes Docker Compose files.

home_page__hero_title: A full-stack starter for TypeScript apps
home_page__testimonial_frontend: I could start with the page I wanted to build. The routing and shared UI already had a place in the project.
home_page__testimonial_full_stack: Having the API contract beside the app made it easier to follow a change from the screen to the database.
home_page__testimonial_platform: The workspace makes it clear what belongs in the web app, what runs on the server, and what the two share.
home_page__testimonial_maintainer: I liked starting with a sign-in flow I could run and read before deciding how to change it.
home_page__testimonial_app: I could see where translations and localized routes belonged before the first page needed a second language.
home_page__testimonial_ui: Shared components gave the first screens a consistent look while leaving room for our own branding.
home_page__footer_tagline: A TypeScript starter with the web app, API, and database wired together.
